races.name: Al Basti Equiworld, Dubai Apprentice Handicap Stakes (Whips To Be Carried, But Not Used) (Part Of Racing Excellence)

runners_data.name: Kimeko Glory
runners_data.note: Has shown consistent placed form around 10–12f and drops back to a mile here, but her recent good-ground figures (sim-going 10/15, 3W3P) look promising for conditions; hold-up style suits a waiting game though she needs to grab a forward position early to avoid being swamped in the hold-up pack.

runners_data.name: Sydney Rock
runners_data.note: Returned a useful second on good ground over 7f last time on a quick turnaround (7 days), and a mile on good-to-firm represents a slight unknown; a natural hold-up horse who will need luck in running as the field piles into the straight together.

runners_data.name: Decalogue
runners_data.note: Carries a headpiece (hg:p) and has placed once from three attempts on good ground, but his natural tendency to race from the rear means he is essentially asked to race against his grain in a shape dominated by another lone leader — his STYLE_FIT tag rightly tempers expectations; the redistribution to midfield flatters his likely influence.

runners_data.name: Thiscouldbefun
runners_data.note: The lone confirmed pace-setter and natural beneficiary of her own race shape; hg:p worn, 24 days since last run, and apprentice Isobelle Chalmers takes 3lb — on good-to-firm Salisbury at a mile, an uncontested lead is a genuine tactical weapon even if her raw OR of 61 is the field's lowest.

runners_data.name: Zipwire
runners_data.note: Three-year-old whose best form has come over 10f, so dropping to a mile on quicker ground than ideal introduces a query; genuinely hold-up in style and pushed forward on the map only because of redistribution — will need a strong pace and a clear lane to fire his finish.

runners_data.name: Amathus
runners_data.note: Veteran nine-year-old whose course-form figures are the most persuasive in the field (sim-going 12/15, 3W4P on good); visored today, and a tendency to come from off the pace means he must pick his way through but his proven affinity with these exact conditions makes him dangerous if he can get a clear run.

runners_data.name: Ebn Sabt
runners_data.note: Inconsistent form string (677078) with zero wins from 14 runs on similar going, and wearing a visor suggests connections are searching for an answer; the three-year-old is the field's lightest-weighted runner at 124lbs but his profile gives little encouragement that the race shape will suit him.

races.paceDynamic: Thiscouldbefun is the sole confirmed front-runner in this seven-horse field and, with no genuine rival to press her for the lead, she can dictate a controlled, sustainable gallop around Salisbury's turning mile on good-to-firm ground. With a low draw and an apprentice claimer aboard, she is likely to take up her natural position unchallenged from the off, meaning the pace will be honest but not frantic — exactly the kind of tempo that keeps hold-up runners waiting for a gap that may arrive too late. The entire remainder of the field — Kimeko Glory, Sydney Rock, Decalogue, Zipwire, Amathus and Ebn Sabt — are all hold-up or prominent types by nature, meaning the race shape is overwhelmingly dominated by one style, and those behind will be competing for the same ground late. This race shape most clearly favours a horse capable of making smooth progress from the rear or midfield into the home straight, but the front-runner Thiscouldbefun holds a commanding positional advantage by default and could simply steal a winning break if the pace behind her fails to develop. The field holds markedly more hold-up types than the map can accommodate at the rear; among them, Amathus — with the best recent course-form on this going — and Kimeko Glory appear best placed to actually secure a forward midfield berth and mount a credible challenge.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Thiscouldbefun Steals Lead
scenarios.trigger: If Thiscouldbefun bowls along at a measured gallop and her rivals allow the gap to build around the turn.
scenarios.body: She dictates every yard, controls the tempo from the front and, with no pressure, conserves enough energy to repel closers in the straight; apprentice Isobelle Chalmers (3lb claim) keeps the weight low and the tactics simple.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Closest Pursuer Pounces
scenarios.trigger: If Amathus or Kimeko Glory track Thiscouldbefun in second or third and produce a sustained run from the two-furlong pole.
scenarios.body: A runner who secures a handy position off the pace avoids the traffic trouble that will affect the genuine hold-up horses and can collar the leader as she ties up; Amathus's proven form on good Salisbury ground and course experience make this realistic.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Late Closers Swoop
scenarios.trigger: If the pace quickens sharply early and Thiscouldbefun is pressured enough to set up a truly run-through finish.
scenarios.body: Horses pushed back into genuine hold-up berths — Decalogue, Zipwire or Sydney Rock — would need clear daylight emerging from the turning straight and a strong finishing kick to overhaul rivals who have stolen a march; the congested profile of this field makes threading through traffic a significant ask.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapses Entirely
scenarios.trigger: If Thiscouldbefun sets an artificially slow crawl, causing the field to bunch and reducing the race to a sprint from the two-furlong marker.
scenarios.body: A sprint-finish lottery benefits whoever produces the sharpest acceleration from a clear position; Ebn Sabt and Sydney Rock, both lightly weighted and on quick ground, could grab a place in the chaos, but the overall profile of this field does not strongly favour any individual.

watchPoints.text: Watch Thiscouldbefun in the first furlong — if she jumps cleanly and immediately takes up the lead unopposed, her winning chance increases materially as no rival is positioned to pressure her.

Amathus must be tracked rounding the home turn: if he finds clear daylight from his midfield berth before the two-furlong pole he is on ground he demonstrably handles and could produce a sustained challenge.

Monitor the hold-up cluster of Decalogue, Zipwire and Ebn Sabt — all mapped forward of their natural position, they risk tangling with each other early if any tries to assert; a slow start from any one of them could compromise their race entirely.

Kimeko Glory's drop from 12f to 1m is worth monitoring — if she travels with unusual fluency in the first half-mile it may signal she is sharper than her recent longer-trip form suggests, making her a live each-way danger.

Going is officially Good but the race report reads Good To Firm for this 5:30 slot — any horse with a going concern on firm ground (Thiscouldbefun's FIR run is the only firm-ground form in the field) could be worth reassessing if the ground rides quicker than declared.

races.name: Al Basti Equiworld, Dubai British EBF Fillies' Restricted Novice Stakes (For Horses In Bands B, C And D) (EBF Restricted Race Qualifier) (GBB Race)

runners_data.name: Tiora Time
runners_data.note: Won over 6f on good last time and steps up to 7f here where she can stalk Flooding from a prominent pitch; Colin Keane's booking is a significant positive and her two runs on similar going read 1W1P, making her the most naturally suited to this race shape.

runners_data.name: All Angels
runners_data.note: Showed speed in a 6f debut on good but finished sixth; Kieran Shoemark takes over for Ed Walker and she maps as a hold-up filly who will need the pace to truly stretch — 24 days fresh and stepping to 7f for the first time adds uncertainty.

runners_data.name: Flooding
runners_data.note: Won off the front last time and is confidently mapped as the race's pace-setter; the STYLE_FIT flag is relevant — Marco Botti's filly is essentially racing in role as the lone leader here so the flag is context rather than a hard discount, but rivals will be aware Oisin Murphy may not extend beyond comfortable cruising speed if unchallenged.

runners_data.name: Virtue Humble
runners_data.note: Roger Teal — sorry, Amanda Perrett's stable has been cold at 0/4 in the 14-day window and this filly is lightly raced with an entirely unknown running style, making her the biggest question mark in the field; Jack Mitchell will need to improvise tactically until her natural position clarifies.

runners_data.name: Polgaria
runners_data.note: Has back-to-back eighths on Tapeta and soft ground, carries an explicit fade-in-finish flag, and returns only nine days after her last run; Edward Greatrex inherits a filly whose form profile suggests she will be found wanting if the pace proves anything less than testing over this straight 7f.

races.paceDynamic: Flooding is the lone confirmed front-runner in this five-runner novice and, crucially, faces zero pressure from rivals who can genuinely contest the lead — the field's other prominent type, Tiora Time, has the profile to sit close but not to fight for the front, leaving Flooding to dictate entirely on its own terms at Salisbury's straight seven. The pace will therefore be sustainable rather than searching, set by Flooding (Oisin Murphy) from the front, with Tiora Time stalking just off it, and the two hold-up fillies — All Angels and Polgaria — forced to come from off a tempo that may not stretch far enough to suit them. Polgaria carries a clear fade-in-finish flag and has form over this trip on deeper ground, while All Angels is a once-raced maiden dropped into hold-up role who will need a strong gallop to land her challenge. The tactical verdict is clear: a controlled, uncontested pace through an undemanding five-runner heat overwhelmingly favours the prominent-to-pressing profile — horses tracking the front and able to quicken off a steady gallop hold the structural advantage, while late closers are likely to find the race run at insufficient pace to generate the late momentum they need.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Flooding Controls, Presser Pounces
scenarios.trigger: If Flooding sets its customary honest gallop and the race unfolds at a controlled but genuine tempo without acceleration pressure.
scenarios.body: Flooding bowls along uncontested and the pace, though fair, is not truly searching, which allows a horse sitting close behind to track and pounce approaching the final furlong; this shape is the default given the field composition and the absence of any rival willing to challenge for the lead.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Flooding Wins Wire To Wire
scenarios.trigger: If the tempo proves too tame for the closers and Flooding's rivals find themselves outpaced when the leader quickens clear.
scenarios.body: Flooding's prominent runners are left untroubled through the early and middle portions and Oisin Murphy times a controlled surge in the final two furlongs that the hold-up fillies simply cannot bridge from their deeper positions; with only five runners and no real pressure, Flooding can conserve enough to hold on.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Closers Land Late
scenarios.trigger: If the pace unexpectedly collapses in the final quarter-mile and Flooding fades, giving the hold-up fillies a genuine target.
scenarios.body: All Angels or Polgaria would need Flooding to have set a truly strong early gallop that saps stamina in the closing stages, but Polgaria's documented fade-in-finish tendency and All Angels' limited experience make this combination of circumstances unlikely.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Virtue Humble Emerges
scenarios.trigger: If Virtue Humble's unknown style resolves as an improver who has been held up and produces a progressive display on first run back.
scenarios.body: As a lightly raced unknown quantity her style tag provides no confidence, and with Amanda Perrett's yard running at 0/4 over the last 14 days there is minimal positive signal to elevate this scenario; it remains a small insurance probability only.

watchPoints.text: Tiora Time's positioning is crucial — if Colin Keane slots her directly onto Flooding's heels from the outset she becomes the most dangerous horse in the race, sitting on the perfect wheel for the entire trip.

Flooding's uncontested lead could become a liability if Murphy over-conserves early and rivals are able to close without having to accelerate; monitor whether the early splits are genuinely honest or falsely slow.
Polgaria's fade-in-finish flag combined with a quick nine-day turnaround makes her a significant non-runner risk to in-running prices — watch for any drift in the market before the off.

All Angels needs a searching pace to make her hold-up run work; if the opening half-mile is run at a steady tempo, Shoemark may be forced to switch tactics and commit earlier than ideal, changing her finishing profile.

Virtue Humble's unknown style tag means her draw and early behaviour in the stalls should be watched carefully — if she breaks prominently she could influence the race shape beyond what her bare form suggests.

races.name: Colin Hinton & Mitch Hinton Novice Stakes (GBB Race)
Tattersalls £40,000 EBF Fillies' Novice Stakes (GBB/GBBPlus Race)
British EBF Premier Fillies' Handicap Stakes (GBBPlus Race)

runners_data.name: Model Yuko
runners_data.note: Hold-up style for Roger Varian; has shown her best form at 10f on good ground and steps up markedly in trip to 14f today — the distance is a live question, and sim-going record of only one win from seven tries limits confidence despite the booking of Robbie Downey.

runners_data.name: Green Sky
runners_data.note: Rod Millman's six-year-old arrives in career-best form having won three on the bounce at 12f-14f on good ground, making this trip and going combination exactly her comfort zone; Oisin Murphy's booking is significant, though she must close from rear in a race with genuine pace and she was beaten in a 19f staying race most recently over further.

runners_data.name: Percy's Daydream
runners_data.note: David O'Meara's filly sits prominent naturally and has an excellent sim-going record of 13 runs from 15 in similar conditions; she has hit the frame in four consecutive starts at 10f-12f on good ground and Ben Coen partners her, though she has not won since a 10f victory and may need to step up now off OR 82.

runners_data.name: Gloryous
runners_data.note: Jamie Osborne's front-runner will press for the early lead under William Carson but faces a stronger challenger in Counter Intuitive; her best form has come at 10f and she may find this 14f trip stretching her stamina as the race wears on if a genuine pace is set from the gun.

runners_data.name: Counter Intuitive
runners_data.note: Ed Walker's progressive three-year-old has won her last two starts at 12f on good ground and steps up slightly in trip; Kieran Shoemark rides and she will want to lead, carrying only 129lbs as a three-year-old which gives a natural weight advantage over the older fillies in a race she looks physically and temperamentally suited to.

runners_data.name: Ruby Wedding
runners_data.note: Andrew Balding's three-year-old travelled well to win at 11f on good ground last time and is bred to relish this step to 14f; apprentice Alfie Redman claims 7lbs which offsets the concern about the inexperience of the rider in a competitive handicap, and her recent placed effort on the all-weather adds versatility.

runners_data.name: Liveinthelight
runners_data.note: Ollie Sangster's filly carries a hat-trick of wins in fine form for Jack Mitchell, including back-to-back 12f wins on good ground, but her natural hold-up style means she is likely racing closer to the pace than ideal in this field — a positive angle on form is tempered by the tactical compromise her redistribution to midfield implies.

runners_data.name: Rossa Raheen
runners_data.note: Sangster's second string; won at 12f on good ground on most recent start for Sean Bowen but races as a genuine hold-up type and, like stablemate Liveinthelight, finds herself mapped to midfield due to the volume of hold-up horses in this race, meaning she may lack the late kick she generates when settled further back naturally.

races.paceDynamic: Counter Intuitive and Gloryous represent two genuine front-runners who will contest the early lead over this mile-and-a-half at Salisbury on good-to-firm ground, creating a genuine and honest gallop rather than a dawdle. Counter Intuitive, progressive and in career-best form under Kieran Shoemark, is likely to assert over Gloryous and dictate terms, with Gloryous tracking closely in second and ensuring the pace is maintained throughout. Percy's Daydream and Ruby Wedding will sit prominently just behind the leading pair, leaving the hold-up brigade — Green Sky, Model Yuko, Liveinthelight, and Rossa Raheen — needing to make ground from the rear on a galloping track that suits genuine stayers. This contested, honest shape most clearly favours prominent racers who can travel smoothly behind the pace and quicken at the right moment, with true closers disadvantaged by a genuine tempo over a staying trip. Note that the field holds more hold-up horses than the race shape can comfortably accommodate at the rear — Liveinthelight and Rossa Raheen, both natural hold-up types, are mapped to midfield here but will likely find themselves further back than ideal, making their tasks harder.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Contested Pace, Prominent Wins
scenarios.trigger: If Counter Intuitive and Gloryous press each other from the outset and a genuine honest gallop is established throughout
scenarios.body: Percy's Daydream and Ruby Wedding, tracking the speed from prominent positions, will be ideally placed to challenge entering the straight as the front-runners tire; the consistent prominent style suits horses who can travel without cover and finish from the front half of the field on this galloping track.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Front-Runner Dictates Pace
scenarios.trigger: If Counter Intuitive breaks cleanly and establishes an uncontested lead with Gloryous fading back early, allowing the leader to control fractions
scenarios.body: Counter Intuitive, whose last two wins have come over this exact trip on good ground, could simply dictate and never be seriously challenged if the race falls apart tactically behind; at a light 3yo weight of 129lbs and in sharp form, an uncontested leader can prove very hard to reel in over 1m4f.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Closers Reel Them In
scenarios.trigger: If the front-runners cut each other's throats and the pace becomes truly searching, draining enough for the hold-up horses to close with a real run
scenarios.body: Green Sky, with three wins from her last three starts at 12f-14f, is the most likely beneficiary given her course-and-distance profile and form in peak condition; Model Yuko also holds claims on good ground if the gaps appear in time, though both need everything to go right from off the pace.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Midfield Pair Strike Late
scenarios.trigger: If Liveinthelight or Rossa Raheen manage to find a clear run from their mapped midfield positions despite racing further back than natural
scenarios.body: Both are genuine hold-up types placed in midfield by redistribution due to the volume of closers in this field, meaning they race closer than ideal and may lack the late momentum they need; Liveinthelight's hat-trick of wins shows real ability but a congested midfield position on a track that rewards clean-running horses reduces the probability of this shape delivering.

watchPoints.text: Counter Intuitive and Gloryous will meet head-to-head for the early lead — watch the first two furlongs to see whether Counter Intuitive asserts cleanly or whether Gloryous matches her stride-for-stride, as this determines whether one burns out or both do.

Green Sky is the form horse in the race with three consecutive wins and Oisin Murphy aboard, but watch whether she can find a clear passage from off the pace — if the midfield bunches she could be checked at a crucial moment entering the Salisbury straight.

Ruby Wedding's apprentice rider Alfie Redman (7lb claim) is an unknown quantity in a race where tactical awareness matters; watch how quickly he commits for home, as leaving it too late or too early on a prominent runner could prove costly.

Liveinthelight and Rossa Raheen share the same trainer and jockey bookings suggest both are meant to run — watch whether Sangster's pair end up racing against each other in midfield, potentially compromising both rather than one being given clear priority.

The going report consistently reads Good To Firm across all races on the card — if the ground has dried further than the official description suggests, watch how the hold-up horses with good soft-ground form (Gloryous, Rossa Raheen) cope with the quicker surface late in the race.

races.name: Venture Security Handicap Stakes

runners_data.name: Seven Sisters
runners_data.note: A hold-up filly in good form for Ralph Beckett — won last time at 10f on good ground (19 days ago) and the trip suits — but needs a genuine gallop to close into, which a single unchallenged front-runner may not supply; Edward Greatrex claims.|Supplicate|Roger Varian's lightly-raced three-year-old has won three of her last four starts and is the confirmed pace-setter here; her ability to control fractions entirely on her own terms is the defining factor in this race shape, and her most recent wins at 10f on good ground are directly relevant.|Sudbury Hill|Harry Derham's gelding shows a pattern of running well in staying company (won over 17f, placed over 16f) and drops back to 10f here, which is a concern for stamina use; natural hold-up style means he requires a strong gallop that may not materialise, and blinkers were headgear at latest start.|Akho Mezzna|Oisin Murphy takes over on this Jones-trained three-year-old who naturally races prominently — placed twice at 10f on good ground — but with several horses wanting a forward position, he may be shuffled wider or back from his ideal spot; the hood is noted.|On The Inlet|Newland & Insole's filly is a genuine hold-up type whose best form came over shorter trips on standard going, winning twice at 7-8f on Tapeta — she steps up in trip here on turf for the first time at this course, and her natural style means she is squeezed to the rear by the competitive pace picture; the 27-day break is manageable but the switch to turf and extra yardage add uncertainty.|Storm Point|Ed Walker's colt has a genuine prominent racing style but is pushed back on the pace map by supply constraints — his two wins came on softer ground (soft, standard) and he has not shown his best on good; 35 days since last run, and Kieran Shoemark will need to judge whether to chase Supplicate forward or settle for a watching brief.

races.paceDynamic: Supplicate is the lone confirmed front-runner in a six-runner field and, with no credible challenger disputing the lead, Jack Mitchell can dictate a controlled, sustainable gallop from the front on good-to-firm ground at Salisbury. Storm Point is a natural prominent type and Akho Mezzna will also want to race handy, but with both redistributed into a midfield map position due to the crowded pace end, Supplicate is almost certain to get a soft lead and set the fractions entirely on her own terms. Seven Sisters and Sudbury Hill are genuine hold-up horses who will need the pace to be strong enough to close into, but a single, unchallenged front-runner on a flat track is more likely to produce a steady-to-moderate tempo than a searching one. This race shape strongly favours the front-running and prominent profile — any horse that can sit close to Supplicate's controlled pace and quicken in the straight will be advantaged, while true hold-up types face the risk of a race that simply does not set up fast enough for a late run to count.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Supplicate Dictates Unchallenged
scenarios.trigger: If Supplicate gets away cleanly and is allowed to control pace unchallenged from flag to finish.
scenarios.body: Mitchell sets a measured, confidence-building gallop and kicks on two furlongs out on the fast ground, giving the field nothing to aim at; horses that can race prominently close to the leader are best placed to pounce if she ties up late.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Challenger Applies Pressure
scenarios.trigger: If Storm Point or Akho Mezzna pushes forward and forces a more genuinely run race.
scenarios.body: A faster tempo drains Supplicate's stamina reserves and opens the race up for horses with a strong finish; midfield types who can pick up off a genuine gallop become live contenders over this ten-furlong trip.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horses Finish Late
scenarios.trigger: If the pace collapses in the final two furlongs and creates a sprint finish from midfield.
scenarios.body: A weakening leader produces a wall of horses coming from behind, and the horse with the sharpest turn of foot in the straight benefits; Seven Sisters, with strong recent form on good ground, is best placed of the hold-up types to capitalise.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Race Collapses Into Tactical Crawl
scenarios.trigger: If the field idles behind a dawdling Supplicate and the race is effectively decided by a sprint from the two-furlong pole.
scenarios.body: An extremely slow early tempo turns this into a dash for home and suits the freshest horse or the one with the best sprint; Akho Mezzna, racing prominently with Oisin Murphy, is positioned to benefit from a dash-to-the-line scenario.

watchPoints.text: Watch whether Storm Point or Akho Mezzna attempts to push forward past their mapped position at the start — if either contests the lead with Supplicate, the entire pace dynamic shifts and hold-up horses like Seven Sisters become live dangers.

Supplicate's STYLE_FIT flag (0.92) is a reminder she is listed as Prominent but is effectively functioning as the sole front-runner here — if she is flat or slow from the stalls, the pace shape collapses entirely and the race becomes a tactical scramble.

Seven Sisters is a hold-up filly who needs the race run to suit — monitor whether Edward Greatrex, as an apprentice, can position her close enough to the action if the pace is soft, or whether she gets left with too much ground to make up.

On The Inlet's form is built almost entirely on all-weather Tapeta surfaces over shorter trips — her debut on turf at 10f is a significant unknown and she may find conditions and distance conspiring against her here.|info|Sudbury Hill has contested staying races as long as 17f recently, so the drop to 10f here raises a genuine question about whether he has the speed for this trip on quick ground — watch his market moves for any late confidence from connections.
